title: SKE Crystal Plus Mixed Peach Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Mixed Peach flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods combine the soft, juicy sweetness of ripe peaches with a delicate medley of fruity undertones, creating a wonderfully smooth, rich and indulgent vape. This balanced and refreshing flavour profile makes it perfect for an all-day vape that’s both sweet and satisfying. Designed exclusively for the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods offer a convenient and mess-free vaping experience. Retaining the stunning crystalline design of the popular SKE Crystal Bar disposables, the Crystal Plus pods provide a more sustainable and practical solution without compromising on flavour or style. Each pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine absorption compared to freebase nicotine. Combined with an advanced 1.1ohm mesh coil, these pods ensure exceptional flavour and a consistently satisfying MTL (Mouth-To-Lung) vaping experience. The prefilled design eliminates the need for refills or coil changes – simply replace the pod when it’s empty, and you’re ready to continue enjoying the delicious Mixed Peach flavour. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
